items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Chester Zardes on bass. Stanley Williams on drum. Bigfoot Bill was on drum. And Pichon was on the piano. I was playing the band

ctx.x: Chester Zardes on bass. Stanley Williams on drum. Bigfoot Bill was on drum. And Pichon was on the piano. I was playing the band, and Clifford Brown on trumpet, Gordette was on trumpet. That's Clifford Brown. Oh yes. And we had a boy from out of town playing trombone. Can't remember his name. That was?
